*   Topic: Why the sky is blue.
    *   Constraint: Exactly two sentences.

    *   Sunlight is made of all colors (spectrum).
    *   Earth's atmosphere consists of gases and particles.
    *   Shorter wavelengths (blue/violet) scatter more than longer wavelengths (red/yellow) when they hit gas molecules (Rayleigh scattering).
    *   Our eyes perceive this scattered light as blue.
